long_biography.plain_text:
Francis Lapp founded Sunreef Yachts after the charter catamarans he operated failed to offer the quality and space he wanted. He commissioned a larger design around the interior, then recognised a market when a charter client bought the resulting boat. Sunreef made large, customised luxury catamarans its manufacturing speciality.

A factory fire later destroyed the Gdańsk production site with several yachts under construction. Lapp immediately moved work to another hall and rebuilt, preserving orders and employment. He has since extended production to the United Arab Emirates and developed solar-integrated composites, electric propulsion and energy-efficient onboard systems. Lapp remains founder and president as the group expands across both manufacturing centres.
